sections.heading: Talking about the past
sections.body: The preterite (*el pretérito*, also called *el indefinido*) is the past tense for completed actions: things that happened and finished at a specific time. *Ayer hablé con mi madre.* (Yesterday I talked to my mother.) In Latin America it is the everyday past tense — used even for things that happened a few minutes ago: *¿Ya comiste?* (Did you eat already?)

sections.heading: Regular -ar verbs
sections.body: Take off *-ar* and add these endings. Notice the written accents on *yo* and *él/ella* — they change the meaning: *hablo* (I speak) vs. *habló* (he spoke).

sections.heading: Same as the present?
sections.body:
The *nosotros* form is identical to the present: *hablamos* means "we speak" or "we spoke". Context and time words make it clear: *Ayer hablamos con Luis.* (Yesterday we talked to Luis.)

Spelling changes in the *yo* form keep the sound: *llegar → llegué*, *buscar → busqué*, *empezar → empecé*, *jugar → jugué*, *pagar → pagué*, *tocar → toqué*. The other forms are regular: *llegaste, llegó…*

sections.heading: Past time words
sections.body: *ayer* (yesterday), *anoche* (last night), *anteayer* (the day before yesterday), *la semana pasada* (last week), *el mes pasado* (last month), *el año pasado* (last year), *el lunes pasado* (last Monday), *hace dos días* (two days ago), *hace una semana* (a week ago), *en 2020* (in 2020), *ya* (already), *todavía no* (not yet).

examples: Yesterday I talked to my mother.
Last night we had dinner at a restaurant.
Mi hermano trabajó mucho la semana pasada.
My brother worked a lot last week.
Compré una camisa y unos zapatos.
I bought a shirt and some shoes.
Busqué mis llaves, pero no las encontré.
I looked for my keys, but I didn't find them.
El año pasado viajamos a Colombia.
Last year we traveled to Colombia.
Ella tocó la guitarra en la fiesta.
She played the guitar at the party.
Hace dos días estudié en la biblioteca.
Two days ago I studied at the library.
I haven't talked to him yet.
El tren llegó a las nueve.
Did you listen to the song?
Mis padres visitaron México el mes pasado.
My parents visited Mexico last month.
The day before yesterday I walked through the park.
Jugué al fútbol con mis amigos.
I played soccer with my friends.
